game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Village Green, the green outside the walls: the knight must hold off thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against thieves.
theme: The Kingdom – Village Green: the green outside the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Village Green, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against thieves. Then check potion and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from thieves in Village Green: keep potion above zero until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 1, Level 8, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

learning_objectives: Understand the idea behind: Variables & Assignment
Apply “Inventory Slots” in a short challenge
Predict what the code does before running it
Notice and fix a mistake in the code

ui.title: Village Green: Inventory Slots
ui.subtitle: Hold out until the timer ends!

hint: Read the code panel: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against thieves. Keep potion above zero until the timer reaches 41.

tutorial.message: Thieves are coming! Watch the potion meter.
Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Survive for 41 seconds to complete the level.

on_win.title: Level Cleared!
on_win.message: You mastered Inventory Slots in The Kingdom!

on_lose.title: Try Again!
on_lose.message: potion ran out. Fix the code sooner and watch the meter!
